nodes.label: yt-dlp selection
details: An older yt-dlp left in AppData no longer overrides the newer bundled one. On launch, the bundled and AppData versions are compared on a dedicated thread, every yt-dlp spawn waits for that comparison, and the stale copy is removed.
Ships with yt-dlp 2026.08.19; the release ritual now refreshes the bundled binary before every signed build.

nodes.label: Updates
details: Each launch sends one updater.json request instead of two; the log-only Rust check in setup is gone.
Dev builds no longer request updater.json.

nodes.label: Privacy
details: Removed the optional usage and crash telemetry from Debugging settings. RuForge sends no usage stats or crash reports.
